title: Dealmaking in Florida
summary: Watch Dealmaking in Florida and explore more insights from Brixmor on retail, redevelopment, and community. Check out the latest from our blog.
body_markdown:
Looking back on a great[ICSC](https://www.linkedin.com/company/2346552/admin/page-posts/published/?share=true) @Florida!


Over two productive days, the Brixmor team held more than 100 meetings, strengthened industry relationships and explored new opportunities across our portfolio.


[Kristen K. Moore](https://www.linkedin.com/company/2346552/admin/page-posts/published/?share=true) and[Laura McLaughlin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/2346552/admin/page-posts/published/?share=true) also shared their expertise as panelists, with Laura helping organize ICSC+SPECIALTY, held alongside the conference.


We capped off the event with a cocktail reception at Pointe Orlando!


Thank you to everyone who met with our team and joined us at Pointe Orlando. We enjoyed connecting with you and look forward to seeing you next year!
